unmapped_findings: Fe-30Mn-1.2C-6Al is an intermediate Al variant whose mechanical data fall between the Al-free Fe-30Mn-1.2C alloy (as-homogenized reference: 360 MPa YS, 830 MPa UTS, 77% TE) and the Fe-30Mn-1.2C-8Al alloy (source: b0024).

The 4 wt.% and 6 wt.% Al alloys are only very weakly affected by the applied aging treatments in terms of mechanical data, unlike Fe-30Mn-1.2C (weakening/embrittlement) and Fe-30Mn-1.2C-8Al (strengthening) (source: b0024).

In Fig. 4 (tensile strength vs elongation to fracture), the Fe-30Mn-1.2C-6Al series, spanning all heat-treatment conditions (not only as-homogenized), lies at ~670–770 MPa tensile strength and ~30–55% elongation to fracture (source: figure_004).

Fig. 1 indicates a mass density of ~7.15 g/cm³ at ~6 wt.% Al for Fe-Mn-Al-C alloys, but the Mn content of that data point is not explicitly identified, so the value is not attributed to Fe-30Mn-1.2C-6Al (source: figure_001).
